# Champion Tokens (CT)
> The premier automated Fortnite 1v1 matchmaking, wager battle, and tournament esports platform.

## Overview
Champion Tokens (https://championtokens.fun) provides real-time matchmaking for competitive Fortnite players with instant wager payouts, custom cosmetics, and live ladder rankings.

## Core Features
- **Matchmaking & Wagers**: Boxfights, Realistic 1v1, and Zone Wars (1v1 up to 4v4) with automated host lobby codes, wagering from 0.25 to 500+ CT, and real-time ledger settlement.
- **Champion Premium**: VIP membership granting golden username styling, VIP crown badges, player tipping, priority matchmaking, and zero platform fees.
- **Custom Player Cosmetics**: Over 30 unique hand-crafted avatars (Exclusive, Epic, Rare, Uncommon) refreshed daily at 00:00 UTC, and equipped player titles.
- **Tournaments**: Automated bracket competitions, prize pools, and live leaderboards.
- **Redeem & Gift System**: Token codes, cosmetic unlocks, and GearUP Booster PC membership keys.
- **Platform Currency**: Champion Tokens (CT) pegged 1:1 with USD ($1.00 USD = 1.00 CT). Minimum withdrawal is 5.00 CT.

## Security & Fair Play
- Anti-cheat enforcement: Replay file / video proof submission required for score disputes.
- Real-time Firestore transaction ledger with server-side balance verification.
- Prohibited: Alternate accounts, third-party software/macros, toxic conduct, match-fixing.
- Vulnerability reports: Contact administration via Discord or security.txt.
